scheme_name: West Bengal Handloom and Khadi Weavers Financial Benefit Scheme 2024: Supply of Yarn to Societies etc. at Subsidized Rate
other_conditions: The yarn discount does not apply to yarn procured under the NHDP Scheme.
benefits_summary: Provides a 10% discount on yarn to eligible handloom and khadi societies, with a 5% administrative cost reimbursement to the supplying agency.
